patterns.note: Alternating full-width content sections with varying background colors (light beige, dark charcoal, vibrant orange, purple) to delineate content blocks and create visual rhythm.
Prominent use of an elegant, large-scale serif typeface for primary headings, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text, subheadings, and labels.
A sophisticated palette combining warm, muted neutrals (light beige, off-white, subtle grey) with deep, rich dark tones and a vibrant, energetic orange as a primary accent and CTA color.

The navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll. Background images in hero and full-width sections exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than foreground content.
Full-bleed image sections with text overlays are used to introduce key concepts or transitions, often featuring a subtle parallax scroll effect.

technique_notes: The navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility as the user scrolls down the page.

Background images in hero and full-width content sections are set to parallax, creating a sense of depth by scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content. This effect is likely achieved using GSAP ScrollTrigger or a similar library.

Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with clean, legible sans-serif for body and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: inputs, buttons, and image corners have a slight, consistent rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy: generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of classic, elegant serif typography for headlines with a modern, clean sans-serif for body text. This, combined with a warm neutral and vibrant orange palette and subtle parallax scrolling, creates a high-end, trustworthy yet approachable brand identity that elevates a utility service.
